description.en: Forces a match member to use a given technique/skill by ID, looked up by team slot and character ID.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Character ID string identifying which member should use the skill.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Force a match member to immediately use a specific technique
CMND_BTL_USE_SKILL(0, "para_cp0008", "whs0035");
